newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris freighter flights increase in Jan-Nov '96.
newsitem.headline: Paris freighter flights increase in Jan-Nov '96.

text.p: The number of freighter flights operating at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly totalled 17,599 during the period January-November 1996, an increase of 1.8 percent on the same period the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighter flights operating at CDG between totalled 16,205, an increase of 10.3 percent on the first eleven months of 1995.
The number of freighter flights operating at Orly airport fell by 46.7 percent to 1,394 flights.

Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.2 percent of global flights operating at the Paris airports between January and November 1996, compared to 3.4 percent during the same period in 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
